description: Machine-readable input, evidence, output, and risk contracts for selected high-value scenario routes.

evidence_requirements: Bucket region, endpoint, website configuration, and object accessibility are read back.
Custom-domain DNS/CNAME and HTTPS certificate deployment are verified when used.
A bounded HTTP request distinguishes website, permission, origin, and DNS failures.
risk_boundaries: Bucket policy, ACL, website configuration, CDN, DNS, and certificate changes require explicit confirmation.
Do not expose object data, access keys, or secret policy values in results.

evidence_requirements: Resource state, metric namespace/dimensions, and time range are identified before drawing a health conclusion.
Log and alarm evidence is narrowed to the declared workload and time window.
Missing telemetry is reported as a coverage gap rather than a healthy result.
risk_boundaries: Do not create or modify alarms without an explicit confirmation flow.
Treat log content, trace identifiers, and alarm payloads as potentially sensitive.

evidence_requirements: Inventory, lifecycle state, binding state, and tag evidence are kept together for each candidate.
Billing facts, period, scope, and money basis are stated before cost conclusions are made.
Dependencies and rollback checks are captured before a teardown recommendation.
risk_boundaries: Idle candidates are not deletion authorization.
Billing, trace, tag, and resource identifiers must be summarized or redacted when sensitive.

evidence_requirements: Image identity and pull authorization are verified without exposing credentials.
Namespace, network, workload, Service/Ingress, logs, and metrics are checked in dependency order.
Workload readiness is followed by endpoint or protocol evidence before declaring the application available.
risk_boundaries: Network, workload, Service, Secret, Ingress, and public exposure changes require explicit confirmation.
Do not return image-pull credentials, Secret values, or tokens.
